title: Code Editor Row Fragment Replay Contract v1
problem: Reduce residual code-editor row-scene prepaint planning cost after local editor-paint attribution proved the remaining owner is per-row cache probing and replay-plan assembly, not renderer text prepare or key comparison.

repro.summary: Use the local complex-wheel editor paint probe with FRET_CODE_EDITOR_DIAG_PAINT_PERF=1 to measure code_editor_paint_perf.p95.us_row_scene_prepaint_probe before and after each slice.
commands: cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag perf tools/diag-scripts/ui-gallery/code-editor/ui-gallery-code-editor-torture-decorations-soft-wrap-inline-preedit-composed-wheel-steady.json --repeat 3 --warmup-frames 5 --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_A11Y_DISABLE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_BOOTSTRAP_FONTS=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_CODE_EDITOR_TORTURE_OVERLAY=0 --env FRET_CODE_EDITOR_DIAG_PAINT_PERF=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --sort time --top 15 --json --dir target/fret-diag/<dir> --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-ai,gallery-chart,gallery-dev,gallery-web-ime-harness
cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag stats target/fret-diag/<dir>/<bundle>/bundle.schema2.json --sort time --top 15 --json > target/fret-diag/<dir>/worst.stats.json

continue_policy.notes: Continue only with row-fragment replay contract changes that reduce per-row prepaint probe/assembly cost while preserving row overlay, preedit, and boundary scene-fragment semantics. Do not reopen the closed prepaint-planner lane or start renderer text/glyph residency unless fresh formal attribution makes renderer prepare dominant.
